title: keel charter
description: The frontmatter of .keel/charter.md (L0, Board-signed, budget 6 KiB for the whole file). The frontmatter holds every machine-read part: mission, invariants, decision boundaries, precedence, reserved-action additions, pitfalls and the root signer. The Markdown body explains them for humans and must contain the level-2 sections in x-keel-sections, in order; further sections may follow. Changes take effect only once signed; every artifact stamps charter_version, and the frame gate flags a MAJOR or MINOR lag.
$comment: x-keel-sections is an annotation keyword registered by scripts/validate.mjs, which checks mapped Markdown examples against it.

root_signer.description: Fingerprint of the root Board signer. allowed_signers changes chain back to it, and keel init records trust on first use.

reserved_actions.description: Reserved actions beyond the canonical table.

additions.description: Project-specific reserved actions; every action in org/reserved-actions.yaml always applies.

precedence.description: The precedence order, highest first: Board ruling > INV > accepted ADR obligation > frozen intent (ACC, non-goals, scope) > requirement > plan > task notes > model preference. Every brief ends with it.

invariant.description: One INV obligation. In-scope invariants are delivered in the brief and join the ACK id set.

level.description: INV obligations are must or must_not.

check.description: Optional check command, run in the verify gate without a shell.

cheap.description: When true the check also runs in the submit gate.

decisionBoundaries.description: Decision boundaries. The four stop classes always force an ask to the Board regardless of these lists.

may_decide.description: Items a seat may decide and record as a ruling.

must_ask.description: Items that always become an ask.

incident.description: Incident id the pitfall cites; a pitfall is admitted only with one.
